card.name: Lab animals in dosing study sentences
card.fires_on: Animal species names (rats, rabbits, mice) and the verb 'were' right after them, in animal reproduction or toxicity study descriptions. Also 'human' in 'recommended human dose'.

modes.label: Species name

modes.description: The verb 'were' after a list of pregnant animals, before treated or administered.

modes.label: Human in dose comparison
modes.description: The word 'human' in 'maximum recommended human dose'.
